atoms.text:
(A shuffling noise can be heard. In the distance, something falls and clatters on the ground, echoing loudly in the cave. The audience can now see Thatcher the Thief sneaking around in the background.)

Ted the Tender: What was that? (in a louder voice) Come out, whoever you are! We know you’re there!

(Thatcher the Thief hesitates and then comes out of the shadows into plain sight.)

Thatcher the Thief: (stammering) I need the jewels to feed my family. You see, we have no money left for food after Mayor Magnolia raised the taxes. But I’ll leave now, I didn’t mean to anger you, oh mighty dragons. (says in a small voice) Please don’t eat me!

Rubellious the Ridiculous: (huffing) That’s ridiculous!

Ted the Tender: (sighing) Come up with new words, Rubellious! But in this case, I actually agree! Absolutely ridiculous. First of all, human, we don’t eat meat. We’re very strict vegetarians. Secondly, there are no jewels here! All you’ll find in our cave is a bunch of carrots. And finally, that mayor is a liar!

atoms.text:
Thatcher the Thief: What? Vegetarian dragons? No jewels? And why would Mayor Magnolia lie to us?

Rubellious the Ridiculous: I can think of a couple of reasons why Mayor Magnolia would lie, one reason being the mayor wants us gone. And another reason is that Mayor Magnolia has always wanted that treasure for herself.

Ted the Tender: What do you say, thief, do you want to find out what the mayor is up to? I, for one, am ready for an adventure.

Thatcher the Thief: Promise I won’t end up in your belly?

Rubellious the Ridiculous: (holding out a claw for Thatcher the Thief to shake) Pinkie claw promise!

instruction.text: Select the person that is supposedly lying to the town about where the jewels are.

atoms.a: According to Rubellious the Ridiculous, why would Mayor Magnolia lie about the dragons stealing the jewels?

b.sound: He believes Mayor Magnolia wants the dragons gone and the treasure for herself.
Rubellious thinks the mayor is confused and lost the treasure.

Which feelings does Thatcher most likely have when he first meets the dragons?
Which feelings does Thatcher most likely have when he decides to join the dragon’s quest?

atoms.a: Why is Thatcher looking for the jewels?

b.sound: His family can’t afford to buy food because Mayor Magnolia raised the taxes. He wants the jewels to have money for groceries.
He wants to steal back the jewels in order to give them back to Mayor Magnolia.

atoms.a: What is the reason for Thatcher the Thief joining the dragon’s quest to find out where the jewels are?

b.sound: Thatcher wants to uncover why Mayor Magnolia would lie about the jewels being stolen.
He wants the jewels for himself to buy a yacht for his family.
